zabbix_agent2_run_dir.description: Directory for Zabbix Agent 2 runtime files, including PID file.

zabbix_agent2_stop_retry.description: Retry strategy for stopping the daemon (signal/delay/signal/delay). Enum: ["TERM/30/KILL/5", "KILL/5"]

zabbix_agent2_user.description: User account under which the Zabbix Agent 2 process runs.

zabbix_agent2_group.description: Group account under which the Zabbix Agent 2 process runs.

zabbix_agent2_server.description: IP address or DNS name of the Zabbix server/proxy for passive checks.

zabbix_agent2_server_active.description: IP address or DNS name of the Zabbix server/proxy for active checks.

zabbix_agent2_hostname.description: Unique, case sensitive hostname for the agent.
